'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man, attempting to stab two soldiers at a [[road junction]] near [[Nablus]] in the [[West Bank]], is shot and killed by an [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] commander. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/israeli-forces-shoot-dead-suspected-palestinian-attacker-in-west-bank-idUSKBN29V18C?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornadoes of 2021]]
**[[List of United States tornadoes in January 2021]]
***An EF3 tornado hits [[Fultondale, Alabama|Fultondale]], [[Alabama]], killing one person and injuring 30 others. [https://apnews.com/article/alabama-weather-birmingham-9111aa9ec1c629c58e5e86f8f7c36e1d (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
*****[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] orders an additional 200 million doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] to be distributed by the end of August. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/biden-administration-orders-additional-200-million-doses-covid-19-vaccine-n1255744 (NBC News)]
*****[[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Kamala Harris]] and [[Second Gentleman of the United States|Second Gentleman]] [[Doug Emhoff]] receive their second doses of [[Moderna]]'s [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] at the [[National Institutes of Health]] center in [[Bethesda, Maryland|Bethesda]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/kamala-harris-covid-vaccine-b1793228.html (''The Independent'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alaska]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Alaska]] reports its first case of the UK variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. [http://www.newsminer.com/alerts/coronavirus-uk-variant-detected-in-alaska-for-the-first-time/article_c1f366f6-6031-11eb-b700-7fcfd71ad89d.html (Newsminer)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kentucky]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Kentucky]] reports its first two cases of the UK variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://apnews.com/article/public-health-coronavirus-pandemic-kentucky-31b1ba41f718c6fe0f29af7215b775ea (AP)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]], [[face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
*****The [[Wisconsin]] [[Wisconsin State Senate|State Senate]] votes to repeal the statewide mask mandate imposed by [[Governor of Wisconsin|Governor]] [[Tony Evers]]. [https://apnews.com/article/public-health-legislature-wisconsin-health-coronavirus-pandemic-9f65392f122765cb30d769bec5d15bcc (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Barbados]]
****The [[Caribbean Public Health Agency]] reports the presence of [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|B.1.1.7 variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in [[Barbados]]. [https://gisbarbados.gov.bb/blog/carpha-confirms-uk-covid-19-variant-in-barbados/ (Government Information Service Barbados)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] surpasses one million cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/26/doctors-forced-to-reject-patients-as-indonesia-passes-1m-cases (Al Jazeera)]
****A record 10,868 recoveries are reported in the past 24 hours. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5349277/jabar-nyaris-4-ribu-ini-sebaran-13094-kasus-baru-covid-19-ri-26-januari (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] approves the [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] for use in the country. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/rJ7FC00a100 (Ynet News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record of 959 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, including 914 cases in [[Samut Sakhon]] reported yesterday evening, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 14,646. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2057367/thailand-logs-record-high-959-covid-cases-tuesday (''Bangkok Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
****The [[United Arab Emirates]] reports a record 3,601 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 285,147. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1798691 (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]]
****[[Uzbekistan]] lifts its restrictions aimed to combat the spread of COVID-19 and announces that concert halls will be allowed to reopen at 50% capacity. [https://en.trend.az/casia/uzbekistan/3370757.html (Trend)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****The [[Government of Ireland|government]] extends the Level 5 [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] restrictions until March 5. They also agree to impose a 14-day mandatory hotel [[quarantine]] for all travelers without negative [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 test result]]s as well as all travelers from [[Brazil]] and [[South Africa]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2021/0126/1192030-ireland-covid-latest/ (RTÉ)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a record 291 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 11,012. [https://expresso.pt/coronavirus/2021-01-26-Covid-19.-Mais-291-mortes--um-novo-maximo--e-10.765-infetados.-Ha-ainda-13.728-recuperados-em-Portugal (''Expresso'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] surpasses 100,000 deaths from COVID-19, becoming the fifth country to do so after the [[United States]], [[Brazil]], [[India]], and [[Mexico]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-55814751 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]]
****[[President of Peru|President]] [[Francisco Sagasti]] announces a total lockdown in the capital [[Lima]] and nine other regions following a significant increase in [[Coronavirus disease|COVID-19]] cases. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/27/peru-volunteer-in-sinopharm-vaccine-trial-dies-of-covid (Al Jazeera)]
****The [[Cayetano Heredia University]] says that a volunteer in the local trial of a coronavirus vaccine produced by China's [[Sinopharm Group]] has died from COVID-19-related pneumonia. The university said that the volunteer had received the placebo. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-sinopharm-peru-idUSKBN29V2FD (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia]]
****The [[Ministry of National Defense (Colombia)|Minister of National Defense of Colombia]], [[Carlos Holmes Trujillo]], dies after contracting COVID-19. [https://news.yahoo.com/carlos-holmes-trujillo-colombian-defence-123318962.html (''Yahoo News'')]
**The number of worldwide confirmed [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] cases surpasses 100 million. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/global-covid-19-cases-top-100-million-new-strains-emerge-n1255544 (NBC News)]
*[[2020–21 H5N8 outbreak]]
**The highly pathogenic [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N8|H5N8]] [[avian influenza]] is reported in two backyard hobby grey crowned cranes in [[Central Italy]], who are killed along with ten healthy birds to prevent spread. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-birdflu-italy/italy-reports-h5n8-bird-flu-oubtreak-in-central-part-of-the-country-oie-idUSKBN29V2BA (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
**Acting [[United States Attorney for the District of Columbia|U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia]] [[Michael R. Sherwin]] announces that 400 suspects have been identified and 135 people have been charged in connection to the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|storming]] of the [[United States Capitol]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/doj-identified-400-suspects-charged-135-capitol-riot/story?id=75497113 (ABC News)]
*[[2020–2021 Indian farmers' protest]]
**[[Samyukt Kisan Morcha]] protestors [[2021 Indian farmers' Republic Day protest|storm]] the [[Red Fort]] in [[Delhi]], clashing with police. One protestor is killed and more than 80 police officers are injured. Protest leaders blame the violence on "rogue elements", and say they will continue to dispute the government's [[2020 Indian agriculture acts|agriculture acts]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-55817628 (BBC News)]
*[[Trump administration family separation policy]]
**Acting [[United States Attorney General]] [[Monty Wilkinson (lawyer)|Monty Wilkinson]] announces that President Biden has rescinded the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]]'s zero-tolerance policy, which led to the separation of over 3,000 migrant families on the [[Mexico–United States border]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/ap-exclusive-doj-rescinds-zero-tolerance-immigration-rule/2021/01/26/c840fb1c-601e-11eb-a177-7765f29a9524_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*Colombian businessman [[Alex Saab]], an affiliate of [[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] who is charged in the United States for alleged [[money laundering]], is placed under [[house arrest]] in [[Cape Verde]]. [https://manilastandard.net/news/world-news/345464/alleged-maduro-money-launderer-under-house-arrest-in-cape-verde.html (AFP via ''Manila Standard'')]

**[[Prime Minister of Italy|Italian Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] resigns amid a political crisis over the government's handling of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy|COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-55802611 (BBC News)]
*[[Cabinet of Joe Biden]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes 78–22 to confirm [[Antony Blinken]] as the 71st [[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]]. [https://apnews.com/article/joe-biden-donald-trump-biden-cabinet-antony-blinken-cabinets-d74929057a9e8e5f74e0ee553a6baced (AP)]
